Universal Doctor Speaker is a multilingual app providing key medical phrases translated across 17 languages with audios to facilitate communication between patients and healthcare professionals who don't share a common language.

The app can be used by patients, as well as healthcare professionals to communicate with foreign patients.

FEATURES

1) Verified Medical Translations with Audios

Universal Doctor Speaker comes with over 500 commonly used medical phrases in 17 different languages with accompanying audios by native speakers.

This content has been carefully reviewed by a variety of medical professionals, professional linguists and translators, and different medical associations.

Universal Doctor Speaker is a pocket version of Universal Doctor Speaker WEB - a multilingual medical translations web platform used by Hospitals, Governments and Healthcare Professionals around the world. For more info, visit www.universaldoctor.com


2) Works Offline

Once downloaded, all the translations and audios are on your device for offline use - no need for WIFI or a data connection to use the app.


3) Search Function

Looking for a particular phrase? Use the search bar to find exactly what you want to say.


4) Translations Organized to Facilitate Medical Visits

Content is organized into various medical chapters to help facilitate multilingual medical visits. Patients can use the app to describe:

• Immediate medical needs 
• Symptoms 
• Medical history
• Or ask questions regarding medical treatment

Healthcare professionals can use the app to understand and explain:

• Anamnesis of symptoms by system and specialty
• Physical examination procedures
• Diagnosis
• Treatments


5) Free Updates with New Languages, Content and Features

Get Universal Doctor Speaker and gain access to continuous (always free) updates, including new languages, phrases, features and more. No matter how many new languages we add, your updates will always be free.
